earlierRuns: r43-1 (2026-10-01 06:02Z) and r43-2 (06:05Z) also passed the R-43 assertions (work_items:list answered through the portal, plans:list refused) but each failed one auxiliary tools/list check: r43-1 because the harness cut the response body to 4000 characters and work_items:list's long description pushed blueprint:submit past the cut; r43-2 because the VM's tools/list call hit a 90 s connection timeout to the portal that the retry helper did not retry. Both harness defects were fixed (body cap 60000; retry on a curl transport failure) before r43-3 (2026-10-01 06:10-06:12Z), which passed and is the run docs/evidence/p014-hosted-portal-general-tool-live-2026-10-01.json records. In this 2026-10-02 refresh, r43-4 (08:35-08:37Z) got through OAuth client registration and the consent page, then failed one step for a harness reason: its local OAuth callback listener had picked a random fixed port that was already in use (EADDRINUSE), so the consent redirect had nowhere to land. The listener now binds port 0 and the redirect URI is built from the kernel-chosen port; r43-5 is the first run after that fix.

R-43.observed: From a GCP VM on another network, an app that obtained a limited key through MCP OAuth consent on the portal (scope: blueprint:submit, blueprint:status, work_items:list, one harness) called the general tool work_items:list on the hosted workspace through https://app.papercusp.com/api/workspaces/ws-2802cefffb052f989eae2969/mcp and got its result (it lists WI-7). The same key was refused plans:list, which it was not granted.

summary: Live P-014 re-run on 2026-10-02 (r43-5) on the hosted workspace; 5 of 5 assertions passed from 20 P014_OK and 0 P014_FAIL lines.
